description: Deep Strike + TIGHT formation regression (GH bug): placing a formation from Deep Strike at a spot that is a LEGAL deep-strike position (on the board, >9" from all enemies) but OUTSIDE the owning player's deployment zone was being falsely rejected with 'Formation would place models outside deployment zone or overlapping'. Root cause: _validate_formation_position only branched on is_infiltrators_mode, so reinforcement placements fell through to the deployment-zone check. This drives the real reinforcement UI path (select reserves unit -> TIGHT formation -> try_place_formation_at) at board-centre no-man's-land (880,1200) and asserts the 5-model formation actually places. Negative case 1: the next TIGHT group dropped 5.5" from the enemy Witchseekers is INSIDE the 9" exclusion zone. Since the exclusion-zone placement clamp landed, that is no longer rejected — the whole block is held out to the boundary and placed there keeping its shape, the group edition of the single-model clamp (see deep_strike_exclusion_clamp.json). The rule this case guards is asserted directly instead, and harder: every model on the table ends up more than 9" from every enemy. Negative case 2 (off-board edge guard): a TIGHT group anchored at (115,900) leaves the left model's CENTRE on the board (~x=12) but its 32mm base hanging over the left edge (~x=-13); reinforcement/infiltrator validators only test the centre, so before the edge fix the whole row placed off the table. Asserts the group is rejected (placed count stays 10; that anchor is nowhere near an enemy, so the exclusion clamp leaves it alone and the edge guard is still the only thing deciding) — mirrors the single-model try_place_at() board-edge guard.

steps.script:
var m = tree.current_scene
var list = m.unit_list
for i in range(list.item_count):
	if str(list.get_item_metadata(i)) == "U_BOYZ_F":
		list.select(i)
		list.item_selected.emit(i)
		return true
return false

var dc = tree.current_scene.deployment_controller
var p = dc.temp_positions[0]
return p != null and p.y > 560.0 and p.y < 1840.0

# Negative case 1, updated for the exclusion-zone placement clamp: this block is
# aimed 5.5" from the enemy Witchseekers, i.e. INSIDE the 9" exclusion zone. It
# used to be rejected outright; it is now held out to the boundary and placed
# there, exactly as the single-model ghost is.
var dc = tree.current_scene.deployment_controller
dc.try_place_formation_at(Vector2(880, 270))
return dc.get_placed_count()

var dc = tree.current_scene.deployment_controller
var r = dc.calculate_tight_formation(Vector2(115, 900), 5, 32, 0.0, [])
var cx = r["positions"][0].x
return cx > 0.0 and (cx - 25.2) < 0.0
